test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the given sentence.

A man of character, he __stuck to his guns__ even in the most difficult situations.

options.text: To do things that would please people
To stand firm against all difficulties and challenges

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **To stand firm against all difficulties and challenges.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"stick to his guns"** means to refuse to change one's beliefs or actions despite pressure or criticism. (अपने सिद्धांतों पर अडिग रहना) • **Example: **Despite the opposition, she stuck to her guns and continued to advocate for environmental reforms. • **"To stand firm against all difficulties and challenges"** means to remain resolute and determined in the face of adversity. (सभी कठिनाइयों और चुनौतियों के खिलाफ दृढ़ रहना) • **Example: **Even when the going got tough, he stood firm against all difficulties and challenges.** Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4** i.e. To stand firm against all difficulties and challenges. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: To do things that would please people** (लोगों को खुश करने के लिए काम करना) • **Example:** He often goes out of his way to do things that would please people. • **Option 2: To behave disrespectfully** (असम्मानजनक व्यवहार करना) • **Example:** His tendency to behave disrespectfully often lands him in trouble. • **Option 3: To find a treasure** (खजाना खोजना) • **Example:** The children went on an adventure to find a treasure hidden in the old castle. 21c:T743, The correct answer is:** Accept a difficult situation bravely.**
